current_evidence: The council's Making a planning application page and its 'Planning application documents' download page both link the '2020 reviewed 2023' Checklist, Householder (file 4239) and Non-householder (file 4240) files as the latest versions; no later list was found by search.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no requirements at all (Req. items 0; every app type says 'Not covered'). The council's lists contain the following. Householder list: Block plan (all), Flood Risk Assessment (ground-floor development in Flood Zones 2/3), Heritage assessment (listed or curtilage-listed building or scheduled monument), and Levels survey (level change over 0.3 m or raised platform such as decking). Non-householder list: Air quality assessment; Archaeological desk assessment (groundworks in an Area of Archaeological Potential); Block plan; CIL additional information form (new dwellings, or retail over 280 sqm net, all retail in Folkestone); Contaminated land desk study (sensitive uses on or near contaminated land); Daylight/sunlight assessment (fails BRE 45/25-degree tests, Policy HB8); Extraction details (A3/A4/A5); Draft heads of terms (majors with obligations); Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (meadow/scrub/hedgerow or bat-potential buildings, or near SAC/SPA/Ramsar/SSSI/LWS); Protected species surveys; Ecological management plan; Economic statement (majors with job creation or loss, or loss of tourist facilities); FRA (Flood Zones 2/3, or over 1 ha in FZ1); Heritage assessment (listed buildings, Local List, conservation areas); Landscape strategy (all except change of use with no land); LVIA (200+ dwellings or 4 ha, 10,000 sqm or 2 ha, or majors in the AONB); Levels/cross sections; Lighting assessment (floodlighting, manege lighting, or majors in countryside/AONB); Noise assessment; Planning Statement (all majors and departures, including open space at 20+ dwellings, play space at 10+, affordable housing over 10, and health impact over 100 dwellings); Retail impact assessment (over 2,500 sqm outside centres); Sequential test; Soil stability report (landslip areas D and E); SCI (50+ dwellings); Structural survey (conversion of rural buildings); SuDS strategy (10+ dwellings or equivalent); Transport statement and Travel Plan (majors); Tree survey; Viability assessment.
issues.evidence: Householder development and Non-householder development lists, 'ADOPTED VERSION 16 JANUARY 2020' (2020 PDFs, files 997 and 998). These were used because the '2020 reviewed 2023' DOCX versions could not be text-extracted.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link (file 4238) is only the summary 'Local Validation Requirements: Checklist', a 22kB DOCX. The planning page says the checklist is meant 'to complement the guidance documents below'. The requirements and their triggers are set out in the companion 'Householder 2020 reviewed 2023' (file 4239) and 'Non Householder 2020 reviewed 2023' (file 4240) documents, which Grokbot neither recorded nor read.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'To complement the guidance documents below, we've produced a checklist'; links 'Householder (PDF, 133KB)' -> /downloads/file/4239, 'Non-householder (PDF, 152KB)' -> /downloads/file/4240

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank. The current documents are titled '2020 reviewed 2023', and the underlying list says 'ADOPTED VERSION 16 JANUARY 2020'. The date should be recorded as 2023 (review of a list adopted 16 Jan 2020), which would make the list more than 2 years old as of November 2026.
issues.evidence: Download page titles: 'Checklist for planning validation 2020 reviewed 2023'; 2020 PDF header: 'ADOPTED VERSION 16 JANUARY 2020'

issues.detail: Grokbot's Status says the link was 'not readable: blocked/404/login', but the link works. It returns a DOCX file (the download page lists it as 'DOCX, 22kB') that text-scraping tools cannot parse. The council's own page link text wrongly calls these files 'PDF'.
issues.evidence: Download page: 'Checklist for planning validation 2020 reviewed 2023 - DOCX, 22kB'; planning page link text 'Local Validation Requirements: Checklist (PDF, 286KB)'
issues.grok_comment: The DOCX can be parsed: the raw copy (7c9ad19aba) is a readable matrix of national items A–F and local items 1–29 by householder, full and outline. So the link works, but "cannot parse" is wrong.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The status is still wrong (the link works); "cannot be parsed" is withdrawn.

issues.detail: The council download page still lists the superseded 2020 PDFs (files 997, 998 and 999) next to the 2023-reviewed DOCX versions. Anyone re-capturing this council should use the '2020 reviewed 2023' files 4238, 4239 and 4240.
issues.evidence: Planning application documents download page lists both 'Checklist for planning validation requirements 2020' (PDF) and 'Checklist for planning validation 2020 reviewed 2023' (DOCX)

summary: Grokbot's link is the current (2020 reviewed 2023) checklist and it works, but it is a DOCX summary checklist, so Grokbot captured nothing and left the date blank. The real Householder and Non-householder requirement documents (files 4239/4240) were missed, and they contain about 30 requirements. Contents were compared against the 2020 adopted PDFs because the 2023 DOCX files could not be text-read.
